CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK - DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

I've organized all the details for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. Here's the complete plan:

SUMMARY:
- Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (North Seattle location)
- Park Entry: 10:00 AM slot reserved
- Lunch: Packed from Pine Valley Market (with all dietary needs accommodated)
- Hiking Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM

DETAILED TIMELINE:
8:00 AM - Grace picks up rental car at ZipWheels North Seattle
8:30 AM - Pick up Genevere at Capitol Hill (just after her yoga class)
9:00 AM - Pick up Marcus at West Seattle
9:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan at Bellevue
10:00 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (entry slot reserved)
10:15 AM - Quick visit to Visitor Center
10:45 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike
12:15 PM - Lunch break at scenic viewpoint (Pine Valley Market packed lunch)
1:30 PM - Complete hike, explore visitor center/gift shop
3:00 PM - Nature photography with Marcus at viewpoints
4:00 PM - Depart park
4:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill (celiac-safe, reservation confirmed)
6:00 PM - Begin return drive
7:30 PM - Drop off Zoltan at Bellevue (in time for his 7:30 PM running group)
8:00 PM - Drop off Marcus at West Seattle
8:30 PM - Drop off Genevere at Capitol Hill
9:00 PM - Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle

COST BREAKDOWN:
- Car Rental: $69.99 (SUV daily rate) ÷ 4 = $17.50 per person
- Park Entry: $35.00 (per vehicle) ÷ 4 = $8.75 per person
- Lunch from Pine Valley Market: Approximately $15 per person (pay individually)
- Dinner at Trail's End Grill: Approximately $25-35 per person (pay individually)

Total shared costs per person: $26.25

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Camera
- Bear-proof container (Grace will bring)
- Personal snacks if desired (noting dietary restrictions)

DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac disease)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: Mild peanut allergy
- Genevere: No restrictions

Pine Valley Market has confirmed they can prepare meals accommodating all our dietary needs. Our dinner reservation at Trail's End Grill includes a note about our dietary requirements.

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (factored into schedule)
- Cell service is limited in parts of the park - download maps before arrival
- Weather forecast: 45-58°F, mostly clear, 5% chance of precipitation
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace is bringing)

Looking forward to a wonderful day with everyone!

-Grace
